vocabulary.meaning_en: a holiday spent relaxing near the sea
vocabulary.example: We are planning a beach holiday in August.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short holiday in a famous city
vocabulary.note_ar: غالباً عطلة نهاية أسبوع للتسوق والاستكشاف
vocabulary.example: They took a city break in Rome for three days.
vocabulary.note_en: Usually a weekend away for shopping and exploring.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a holiday with exciting, active things like climbing or rafting
vocabulary.example: My brother loves adventure holidays in the mountains.

vocabulary.meaning_en: travelling down a river on a small boat
vocabulary.example: Rafting on a fast river is not for beginners.

vocabulary.meaning_en: spending a holiday living in a tent
vocabulary.example: We went camping by the lake last summer.
vocabulary.note_en: 'Tent' = the cloth house you sleep in when camping.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a holiday on a large ship
vocabulary.example: My parents went on a cruise around the islands.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a trip to see wild animals, especially in Africa
vocabulary.example: We saw lions and giraffes on our safari.
vocabulary.note_en: 'Wild animals' = animals that live free in nature.

vocabulary.meaning_en: travelling cheaply with only a backpack, visiting many places
vocabulary.example: She spent a month backpacking around Asia.
vocabulary.note_en: 'Backpack' = a bag you carry on your back.

vocabulary.meaning_en: going for long walks in nature or mountains
vocabulary.example: Hiking is a great way to stay fit on holiday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: moving through water using your arms and legs
vocabulary.example: The children spent all day swimming in the pool.

vocabulary.meaning_en: lying in the sun to make your skin darker
vocabulary.example: Don't forget sun cream if you go sunbathing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sliding down snowy hills on long boards called skis
vocabulary.example: We go skiing in the Alps every winter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: riding on waves using a special board
vocabulary.example: He learned surfing from the local people.

vocabulary.meaning_en: swimming under the water, often with special equipment
vocabulary.example: The Red Sea is famous for diving.

vocabulary.meaning_en: buying things in shops
vocabulary.example: She went shopping for sunglasses.

vocabulary.meaning_en: travelling around a new place to learn about it
vocabulary.example: We spent the afternoon exploring the old town.
vocabulary.note_en: 'Explore' = to travel around a place to learn about it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who visits a place for fun
vocabulary.example: The castle is always full of tourists.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who travels, often to explore and live like local people
vocabulary.example: As a traveller, he likes to eat local food.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long trip from one place to another
vocabulary.example: The journey across the desert took two days.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short journey to a place and back again
vocabulary.example: We had a day trip to the beach.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an organised visit to see different places
vocabulary.example: We joined a bus tour of the city.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who shows the way and explains things
vocabulary.example: Our guide told us the history of the temple.
vocabulary.note_en: 'Guidebook' = a book with information for tourists.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a book with information about a place for travellers
vocabulary.example: I bought a guidebook before the trip.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a drawing of an area that shows roads and places
vocabulary.example: Can you find the hotel on the map?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a detailed plan or route for a journey
vocabulary.example: Day one of our itinerary is a museum visit.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where people go on holiday, with hotels and activities
vocabulary.example: The beach resort has three swimming pools.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making you feel very happy and interested
vocabulary.example: The boat ride was really exciting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making you feel calm and comfortable
vocabulary.example: A week by the sea was so relaxing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: willing to take risks and try new things
vocabulary.example: Ali is the most adventurous person in our group.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making you feel tired
vocabulary.note_ar: tiring = الشيء المتعب، tired = الشخص التعبان
vocabulary.example: The long walk was very tiring.
vocabulary.note_en: 'Tiring' describes the thing that makes you tired; 'tired' describes the person who feels it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: so good that you cannot forget it
vocabulary.example: Our trip to Egypt was unforgettable.

vocabulary.meaning_en: dark glasses that protect your eyes from the sun
vocabulary.example: I left my sunglasses at the hotel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take things out of a suitcase
vocabulary.example: We unpacked and went straight to the beach.
vocabulary.note_en: 'Pack' = put things into a bag; 'unpack' is the opposite.

vocabulary.meaning_en: directly, without stopping
vocabulary.example: After school, she went straight home.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to turn over and over while moving
vocabulary.example: The ball rolled down the hill.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small mountain
vocabulary.example: There is a small house on top of the hill.

vocabulary.meaning_en: people who live in a particular place
vocabulary.note_ar: local في الإنجليزية ليس لها معنى سلبي
vocabulary.example: Ask the locals for the best restaurant.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a strong wish to travel or move to a new place
vocabulary.meaning_ar: رغبة شديدة في السفر وتغيير المكان
vocabulary.example: After a year at home, I've got itchy feet.

fine_lines.title: tourist vs traveller
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الفرق هنا في أسلوب السفر وليس في نوع التأشيرة. tourist يسافر للمتعة والراحة، يزور الأماكن المشهورة والآمنة ويقيم في فنادق مريحة. traveller يسافر ليستكشف ويعيش ثقافة البلد: يأكل أكل أهلها، يزور أماكن غير مشهورة، وغالباً يسافر بحقيبة ظهر وبتكلفة قليلة.

examples.sentence: The museum was crowded with tourists.
As a traveller, she stayed with a local family.

fine_lines.explanation_en: The difference here is in the style of travel, not the type of visa. A 'tourist' travels for fun and rest, visits famous and safe places and stays in comfortable hotels. A 'traveller' travels to explore and live the culture of the country: they eat local food, visit places that aren't famous, and often travel with a backpack on a small budget.

fine_lines.title: journey vs trip vs tour
fine_lines.explanation_ar: journey رحلة طويلة من مكان لمكان (التركيز على الطريق نفسه). trip رحلة قصيرة إلى مكان ثم العودة. tour جولة منظمة لزيارة عدة معالم في مكان واحد.

examples.sentence: The train journey took ten hours.
We went on a short trip to the lake.
The guide took us on a tour of the palace.

fine_lines.explanation_en: A 'journey' is a long trip from one place to another (the focus is on the way itself). A 'trip' is a short visit to a place and then back. A 'tour' is an organised visit to several sights in one place.

fine_lines.title: tiring vs tired
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الصفة التي تنتهي بـ ing تصف الشيء الذي يسبب الشعور (المشي متعب)، والتي تنتهي بـ ed تصف الشخص الذي يشعر به (أنا تعبان).

examples.sentence: Hiking up the mountain was tiring.
I was too tired to go out after the hike.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Adjectives ending in -ing describe the thing that causes the feeling (the walk is tiring). Adjectives ending in -ed describe the person who has the feeling (I am tired).

expressions.meaning_ar: يشعر برغبة قوية في السفر وتغيير المكان
expressions.example: Every winter I get itchy feet and want to fly somewhere warm.
expressions.meaning_en: to feel a strong wish to travel and go somewhere new

expressions.example: After months at home, she developed itchy feet.
He kept saying that he was hungry.
expressions.meaning_en: to say something again and again

expressions.example: The kids ran straight to the pool.
Let's go shopping for new shoes.
expressions.meaning_en: to go to the shops to buy something specific

expressions.example: We planned our itinerary before we left.
expressions.meaning_en: to make a plan for a trip

grammar.title: Future perfect continuous for cause and effect
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المستقبل التام المستمر (will have been + فعل ing) لنذكر السبب: حدث مستمر لفترة حتى نقطة في المستقبل. ثم نذكر النتيجة بالمستقبل البسيط (will + فعل).
examples: By the time we reach the resort, we will have been driving for five hours, so we will be very tired.
When we get to the station, Omar will have been waiting for three hours, so he will be angry.
grammar.explanation_en: We use the future perfect continuous (will have been + verb-ing) to give the cause: an action that continues for a period up to a point in the future. Then we give the result with the future simple (will + verb).

grammar.title: Future perfect continuous for predictions
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدمه أيضاً للتخمين أو التوقع عن مدة نشاط مستمر حتى وقت معين في المستقبل. غالباً مع by أو at this time next ...
examples: This time next week, they will have been travelling for a month.
By June, I will have been learning English for a year.
grammar.explanation_en: We also use it to guess or predict how long an activity will have been going on by a certain time in the future, often with 'by' or 'at this time next ...'.

questions.question: A short holiday spent in a famous city is a:
questions.explanation_ar: city break = عطلة قصيرة في مدينة مشهورة.
questions.explanation_en: City break = a short holiday in a famous city.

questions.question: A detailed plan for a journey is called an:
questions.explanation_en: Itinerary = a detailed plan for a trip.

questions.question: She likes to eat local food, stay with local families and visit places that are not famous. She is a real:
questions.explanation_ar: traveller يسافر ليستكشف ويعيش ثقافة البلد.
questions.explanation_en: A traveller travels to explore and live the local culture.

questions.question: Lying in the sun to get darker skin is:
Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation_en: 'Skiing' is spelled with two 'i' letters together.

questions.question: After a year in the same city, I have ___ . I need to travel!
questions.explanation_ar: itchy feet = رغبة قوية في السفر.
questions.explanation_en: Itchy feet = a strong wish to travel.

questions.question: By the time we arrive, we ___ for six hours.
questions.explanation_ar: حدث مستمر لفترة حتى نقطة في المستقبل = will have been + ing.
questions.explanation_en: An action continuing up to a point in the future = will have been + -ing.

questions.question: "The walk was very tiring." The word "tiring" describes:
choices: the walk that made us tired
questions.explanation_ar: الصفة بـ ing تصف الشيء المسبب للشعور.
questions.explanation_en: An -ing adjective describes the thing that causes the feeling.

questions.question: "To unpack" means to:
choices: take things out of a suitcase
questions.explanation_en: Unpack = take things out of your bag.

questions.question: A trip to see wild animals in Africa is a:
questions.explanation_en: Safari = a trip to see wild animals.
